limitations: External LLM extraction accuracy, cost and latency not measured.
One personal identity per instance; session IDs are not tenants.
Cold distinct-query overload and residual relevance errors remain.
Semantic forgetting across unknown paraphrases is not guaranteed.
No real 10000-document embedding corpus or hours-long soak test.

regression.replay: 256/256 labelled source writes and eight complete final states

post_expiry_fix.changes: Automatic aging uses its old observation cutoff and a revision guard; explicit deletion still protects all received input.
